item: H2 follow-up candidate 2: cheaper exact geometry and a predicted-sweep certificate
status: adopted after Mac qualification; Linux 16-worker sparse cost remains unresolved

limitations: Incremental Mac qualification against be357256; does not retroactively pass the previous H-wide inconclusive cell or establish a new fixest comparison.

SCC uses two trace-enabled pairs per cell and is descriptive. Sparse at 16 workers costs 15.08% paired geometric mean (individual costs 10.01% and 20.38%); neither dismissed as noise nor claimed as confidence-qualified regression. No Linux performance qualification.
Standard wide64/t4 costs 1.82% with 95% interval [0.46%, 3.28%]; Mac sparse/t4 costs 0.48% [0.04%, 1.10%]. These costs remain visible within the allowance.

All Mac warmup and measured observations retained. In large-case arrays the warmup is first; standard arrays combine block a then b, warmups separate. Each block starts candidate-first warmup, then baseline-first even pairs and candidate-first odd pairs.
Mac excluded concurrent development builds, tests and agent tools; ordinary application activity remained. Preflight snapshots are retained, not continuous monitoring.
Candidate 1 remains separately failed/inconclusive, with its source patch and all observations preserved. No fit retries, timing continuation or selected observations.
